dedupe_keys.name: predist operational data of district heating substations labelled with faults and maintenance information

description: PreDist is a labelled data set of operational time series from district heating substations with fault and maintenance information, for developing early fault detection models. It was published by Cyriana Roelofs and co-authors with data from the network operator enercity Netz GmbH, alongside a paper on enabling predictive maintenance in district heating substations. It holds time series from 93 substations of two manufacturers, each series starting when the substation was digitised, plus for each manufacturer a list of faults from incident reports with short descriptions and problem categories, a list of disturbances (incident reports and corrective and preventive maintenance), feature descriptions, predefined normal events, and since version 2 a list of substation configuration types. Coverage is the 93 substations of one operator's network with varying series lengths. The data are one ZIP of about 267 MB on Zenodo (version 2, April 2026) under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost. Caveats: series lengths differ between substations, labels come from service reports and are incomplete where reports were not matched, and users are asked to cite the paper. Simulation uses are fault detection, condition monitoring and predictive maintenance of heat networks. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
